title: Mechs vs. Minions
subtitle: The Cooperative Programmatic Mech Combat Campaign
tagline: Pilot and program your battle mechs to vanquish relentless minion swarms across 10 sealed mission dossiers.
loreSummary: You are brave Yordles enrolled in Rumble's prestigious mech academy. When a catastrophic minion invasion breaches the facility, you must climb into your custom war-machines, draft action cards onto your command line, program synchronized movements, and execute devastating combat routines to defend the realm.
keyFeatures: Cooperative programmatic action drafting across 10 sealed mission envelopes
Modular map boards featuring dynamic hazards, lava flows, and escort objectives
Pre-painted hero mechs, boss miniatures, and dozens of sculpted minion figures
Progressive unlock dossiers with new command cards, schematics, and gear

mvm_full_campaign.name: Full 10-Mission Campaign
mvm_full_campaign.description: The complete narrative cooperative campaign through all 10 sealed mission dossiers to the final boss mech.

mvm_cadet_missions.name: Cadet Training Operations (Missions 1–5)
mvm_cadet_missions.description: Play the first 5 missions to master programmatic command lines, weapon upgrades, and basic crowd control.

mvm_master_mechanic.name: Master Mechanic Saga (14 Missions)
mvm_master_mechanic.description: The full 10-mission campaign plus 4 advanced challenge scenarios and hardcore boss protocols.

milestones.title: Mechanical Mastery
milestones.description: Master slot drafting, programmatic movement routines, and fuel-injection systems against the first swarm waves.

milestones.title: The Molten Perimeter
milestones.description: Navigate moving lava conduits, tow the fragile crystal payload, and neutralize the minion perimeter fortifications.

milestones.title: Defense of the Rune Forge
milestones.description: Erect defensive energy barriers and coordinate continuous firing lines to protect the academy's power core.

milestones.title: The Megamech Reckoning
milestones.description: Program synchronized offensive protocols to bring down the titanic enemy boss mech and save Runeterra.
